profile.name: Shahir Ahmed
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer and M.S. Computer Science student at New York University. Previously a software engineer at Sarva and a software engineer intern on FarmData2. Ranked 25th of 600+ contributors to Mermaid.js.

highlights: Replaced pen and paper inventory at independent grocery stores with a voice assistant that updates stock in 90+ languages
Integrated Stripe so every payment splits between the store and the driver, and no card is charged until pickup
Improved product and inventory search by 7% by adding semantic search with OpenAI embeddings alongside keyword matching
Built 3 CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions running 2,604 unit tests across 173 REST API endpoints
Sarva was chosen for the gener8tor and Meta gBETA accelerator and named a finalist at the Ship Tank and launchU pitch competitions
experience.summary: Startup that helps neighborhood grocery shops manage inventory by voice, with online ordering, pickup, and delivery.

highlights: Ranked 25th of 600+ contributors by merging 3 pull requests into a diagramming library with 10M+ weekly downloads
Added data labels to bar charts, Knuth-Plass word wrapping for journey diagram legends, and journey diagram title styling in a 100,000 line TypeScript codebase used by GitHub and Microsoft
Wrote Cypress end-to-end tests for each feature
Cut page load time by 60% on a National Science Foundation funded farm platform by moving 22+ Vue.js components to Vuex
Automated crop logging with 18+ Node.js REST APIs and 30+ Cypress tests, saving farmers 12+ hours a week
experience.summary: Paid internship on open source farm record-keeping software funded by the National Science Foundation.

highlights: Raised average assignment scores by 15% for 25+ students across 6 semesters through weekly Python and Java code reviews
Converted 10,000+ lines of legacy CBASIC into Python and Java for a $9B retailer by building a translator with ANTLR

projects.name: GrabPic
projects.description: Event photo search. Upload a selfie to find your photos in albums of 500+ photos, matched in under 200 milliseconds. Three services (Next.js, Spring Boot, Python DeepFace/TensorFlow worker) connected through Amazon SQS, with pgvector HNSW search, S3 presigned uploads, Redis rate limiting, and Cloudflare Turnstile.

projects.name: PaperPulse
projects.description: Research assistant that answers questions from the full text of 100+ papers. Ranks papers from arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex nightly and delivers the 25 most relevant to each user's feed. FastAPI, Next.js, Neo4j, pgvector, AWS App Runner.

projects.name: Queue Up
projects.description: Social app that matches people by Spotify listening history, with real-time WebSocket chat. Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, Docker.

projects.name: CoSign
projects.description: Task accountability app where users can't complete their own tasks. A verifier approves submitted proof through a task state machine, and missed deadlines automatically email the AES-encrypted hidden penalty to the verifier. Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, WebSockets, Docker.

projects.name: BitTorrent Client JS
projects.description: BitTorrent client in Node.js for .torrent files and magnet links, with TCP peer connections, SHA-1 piece verification, and extension protocol metadata exchange.

projects.name: PandOS
projects.description: Operating system kernel in C for the uMPS3 emulator with time sharing, TLB-based virtual memory, system calls, and interrupt handling.

projects.name: Albatross
projects.description: Built at HackHarvard 2024 after two teammates had felt unsafe walking through parts of Boston. Navigation app that routes walkers around high crime areas, built by a team of 4 in 36 hours, using 50K+ crime records grouped into risk zones with MLflow and Databricks. Vue.js, Cloudflare Workers, Google Maps API.

projects.name: SweetFriend
projects.description: Built at PennApps 2024 with a teammate who lives with type 1 diabetes. Dexcom glucose data on a Chart.js timeline (Shahir's React frontend), GPT-4o meal photo carb estimates via Tune Studio, a Cerebras chatbot, Twilio alerts, and a Flask and MongoDB backend.

projects.name: Prospectus
projects.description: Shahir's first hackathon (HoyaHacks 2024). The team designed an AI college admissions assistant with React, Django, and Azure OpenAI, but did not finish a working product in time.

honors: Pi Mu Epsilon (National Mathematics Honor Society)
